children.name: A letter from an English friend
What do you do in your spare time ?

notes: WORKBOOK: Let's Discover More English, 8th Year, Activity Book, the companion to the main Student's Book 141806. It has a lesson-by-lesson activity set and a mock test per module; the mock tests and tape scripts were excluded. Lesson titles come from the LESSON headings. The modules are untitled, so the top level uses 5 positional labels 'Module N'. Module 3 lesson 1 is printed here as 'English secondary schools (1)', an evident copy error. It was named 'Entertainment' as in the Student's Book (p61). Spelling 'shools' was fixed to 'schools'.
